Many private credit firms believe Saudi Arabia offers an estimated $100 billion opportunity, potentially helping transform the Middle East into one of the biggest markets for the asset class. But deploying capital at the required scale and speed is proving difficult.

A recent $150 millionfinancing for a little-known Saudi firm illustrates the challenge. Backed by Goldman Sachs Group Inc., HSBC Holdings Plc, Fortress Investment Group and at least three regional fund managers, and small by Wall Street standards, the deal took months to complete.

최근 잘 알려지지 않은 한 사우디 기업에 이뤄진 1억5,000만 달러 규모의 금융은 이러한 어려움을 잘 보여준다. Goldman Sachs Group Inc., HSBC Holdings Plc, Fortress Investment Group과 최소 3곳의 역내 운용사가 참여했고 월가 기준으로는 소규모인 이 딜을 마무리하는 데 수개월이 걸렸다.
